review: Final product / UX / telemetry / architecture QA

findings.problem: Scenario selection reused another scenario’s passed validation
findings.reproduction: Select normal while slow-rollout is ready: Query remains passed
findings.fix: Scope stages, errors, Stop and replay links to selected execution; show Not started and current owner

findings.problem: Scenario status polling stopped after five minutes
findings.reproduction: Virtual browser clock reaches 120 polls; no further status request
findings.fix: Sequential continuous polling; discard prior command epochs

findings.problem: Replay verification never recovered from a temporary HTTP failure
findings.reproduction: First controller GET returns 503, next succeeds; Run stays blocked
findings.fix: Retry verification and preserve Run/generation/preferences; live Explorer never downgrades to cached legacy catalog after connection loss

findings.problem: Pending KPI query displayed No data
findings.reproduction: Hold native datasource responses; Worker throughput reads No data
findings.fix: Display Loading and suppress contradictory no-observation explanation until terminal response

findings.problem: Synthetic provenance disappeared in Metric library
findings.reproduction: Open compute in a verified synthetic generation; badge absent
findings.fix: Carry provenance into common application chrome on all workspace routes

findings.problem: Mobile scenario cards displaced execution controls
findings.reproduction: 390px screenshot places selected replay action below seven catalog cards
findings.fix: Use a compact mobile selector; keep URL/Back/Forward/Reload and first-viewport action

findings.problem: Mobile keyboard navigation left focus outside the open drawer
findings.reproduction: Enter on Open navigation does not focus Close navigation
findings.fix: Focus entry, constrain Tab/Shift+Tab to drawer, restore trigger on Escape

findings.problem: Investigation summary used half the grid and overflowed its action
findings.reproduction: Actual desktop summary fails full-grid-width assertion; CSS selector cannot match markup
findings.fix: Correct scoped direct-child selector; test both themes at three widths

loops: Independent baseline source review, actual slow-rollout workflow, four failing browser boundary regressions
Fresh source/UI review: provenance, compact mobile selection, keyboard focus and investigation geometry; reproduce then correct
Final full CPU, actual single-Grafana scenario suite, repeated input signature, full Grafana journey and targeted revalidation

architecture.decision: Retain Scenes, canonical datasource/panel contracts, Grafana UI and scoped Emotion; no dependency or telemetry engine changes
strengths: Generation-specific backend stores and stale-response guard
Explicit worker/resource identity and measured-vs-shared scope
Native URL/time context and canonical panels
followups: Separate the large Shell/KPI rendering module when a concrete feature requires it
Reduce compatibility styling overlap; new geometry regression covers the discovered selector defect
Measure sustained telemetry/query overhead and large-history behavior with actual workloads

strengths: Four primary destinations and four core indicators; exact observation boundary retained
Step delta, scoped candidate/evidence and subsystem investigation connected
Missing, stale, unknown, zero and failed query retain distinct semantics
limits: Recorded progress is not process liveness or end-to-end workload health
Single-job scenario candidate oracle uses controlled synthetic producer values; multi-job uses actual DiagnosticEngine results
No first-time external user study or full accessibility certification

pending: Physical multi-node clock offset, uncertainty and source recovery
Real VERL/vLLM sync/async multi-job, replica/policy and request ownership
GPU/RDMA/Mooncake/3FS measurements, shared-resource attribution and overhead
Actual LLM inference; tests cover invocation/projection fixtures
Long-running overhead/retention, screen readers and exhaustive canvas interactions
